-- Sum of the squares of a list. The squares are computed in parallel
-- and collected in input order, then summed in that order, so the
-- result is the same at every thread count.

square(x: int) -> int =
  ex square(3) == 9
  ex square(-4) == 16
  x * x

sum_squares(xs: List[int]) -> int =
  post out >= 0
  ex sum_squares([]) == 0
  ex sum_squares([1, 2, 3]) == 14
  let ys = par for x in xs
    square(x)
  var t = 0
  for y in ys
    t += y
  t
